sourceClaims.claim: five item types by four states produce 20 40x40 primitive variants
the standalone composition demonstrates a window but does not define a generator
native links own navigation while current page, totals, window, URL and router remain consumer-owned

evidence.source-integrity: pass: Pagination.svg primitive/composition split and exact 20-state matrix remain source-tested
evidence.structural-contract: pass: named nav/list/native-link markup, one current page, non-link boundaries and ellipsis are asserted
evidence.runtime-browser: pass: URL-driven first/middle/last navigation updates results; a platform-appropriate trusted Ctrl/Meta click reaches the native anchor uncancelled and leaves the current page unchanged without a library router/controller
evidence.accessibility: pass: native link focus/order, real href, one aria-current and non-anchor disabled directions are browser-checked
evidence.focused-visual: pass: first, middle, last and ellipsis component-local evidence supplements the unchanged bounded typography raster test
evidence.consumer-integration: pass: URL-owned current page and result range execute across all three consumer pages
evidence.responsive-content-stress: pass: 240px component-local list wraps without clipping, hidden scroll or automatic collapse

staticVisual: pass: 20-state matrix, fake hover/pressed items and bounded snapshots remain static visual evidence only
realInteractionVisual: pass: numeric and direction links execute real hover, pointer-down active and keyboard focus computed paint assertions alongside current and disabled boundaries
runtimeBehavior: pass: native URL navigation, modifier click and consumer-owned current page behavior execute independently

interactionEvidence.manualStateWalk: pass: numeric and Previous/Next pointer hover/down, Tab/Enter, current, disabled boundaries and narrow wrap inspected

findings.description: Real and fake hover/pressed paint diverged, while enabled Default, Pressed and Disabled foreground/background/border values also differed from the authoritative Pagination Btn variants.
The source-backed enabled Default foreground #939CA5 on white is below the 4.5:1 normal-text emergency threshold; exact source fidelity is retained without automatic recoloring.

knownLimitations: headless Chromium does not reliably expose a new Page for modified clicks, so evidence proves an uncancelled trusted modifier event on a real href rather than claiming an observed new tab
no page-window generator, router, totals model, automatic collapse or hidden horizontal scrolling
